remarks: *Back on market due to unforeseen circumstances, through no fault of the sellers. Take advantage of this second chance to make this house your home! "Location is everything!" Nestled in the desirable Broad River area of Norwalk, this cherished family home is now available for the first time in 32 years. This classic Cape offering 3 bedrooms w/1 bath, presents a wonderful opportunity to create your dream home. While the property is in need of several updates & repairs, its potential in undeniable. The home is situated on level corner lot & features a partially finished basement creating additional living space, an enclosed porch and a converted garage, which can easily be transformed back. This is a rare find in a sought after neighborhood, perfect for buyers looking to invest in a home they can personalize and make their own. Bonus of being in close proximity to Historic SoNo, which offers so much to do...Variety of award winning eateries, cafes, galleries, shops, breweries, Maritime Aquarium, movie theatre and the impressive SoNo Collection Mall, to name a few. Excellent commuter location with major highways and Metro North train, only minutes away! "Come take a look and see for yourself, Don't miss out on this opportunity to restore and rejuvenate this hidden gem."
